The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Produces a summary table with ease, impact, risk and a one-line explanation per item
- Gives each item an overview, explanation, requirements, ordered implementation steps and testing
- Cites file evidence for each item and makes no code changes
- Notes that a higher Ease number means harder

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
